content.raw:
The signage partner for homebuilders and master-planned communities

Brand 9 Signs is a 40-year homebuilder and community signage company based in Orange Park, FL (Jacksonville metro), serving builders and developers across Florida and the Southeast. We design, fabricate, install, and maintain the complete sign program a residential community needs — from the entrance monument to model-home signage to wayfinding — so your brand looks finished from day one and stays consistent across every phase.

Call (904) 272-3395 or email Team@brand9signs.com to scope a community.

What we build for homebuilders and developers

  • Community monument & entrance signs — the first impression at the entrance, built to HOA/ARB standards and to last in Florida weather.
  • Wayfinding & directional signage — get buyers from the entrance to the models and amenities without confusion.
  • Model-home & sales-center signage — flags, riders, monuments, and interior graphics that sell.
  • Amenity, pool & regulatory signage — clubhouse, pool, dog park, and code-required signs, coordinated in one package.

Why builders choose Brand 9 Signs

Signage is usually the last thing before a community opens and the first thing a buyer sees. Brand 9 Signs has run that hand-off for four decades. We handle design, permitting support, fabrication in our own shop, and professional installation — one accountable partner instead of a designer, a fabricator, and an installer who each blame the others. For multi-community builders, we keep the brand identical across every entrance and every phase.

Where we work

Headquartered in Orange Park, FL, Brand 9 Signs serves the Jacksonville metro and communities statewide — Orlando, Miami, and across Florida and the Southeast. New markets are handled by inquiry.

Talk to us about your community

Send your community plan, phase schedule, and brand standards and we will scope the full signage program. Brand 9 Signs — Orange Park, FL · (904) 272-3395 · rated 4.8/5 across 57 reviews.

title.raw: How Much Do Community Monument Signs Cost? (2026) | Brand 9 Signs
title.rendered: How Much Do Community Monument Signs Cost? (2026) | Brand 9 Signs

content.raw:
How much do community monument signs cost?

A community or neighborhood monument sign typically costs about $8,000 to $60,000 or more. A modest single-face masonry-and-metal entrance sign often runs $8,000–$20,000; a large, illuminated, double-entry monument with stone veneer and landscaping can reach $30,000–$60,000+. The final price depends on size, materials, lighting, foundation and site work, permitting, and how many entrances you're signing.

Brand 9 Signs — a 40-year homebuilder signage company in Orange Park, FL — provides a fixed quote after reviewing your community plan. Call (904) 272-3395.

What drives the cost

  • Size & height — larger and taller signs need more material and heavier foundations.
  • Materials — concrete/masonry, aluminum, acrylic, and stone veneer each carry different costs and lifespans.
  • Lighting — external flood, halo-lit, or push-through LED lighting adds electrical and fabrication cost.
  • Foundation & site work — footings, grading, and running power to the entrance.
  • Permitting & engineering — many jurisdictions require sealed drawings and permits.
  • Number of entrances — matching monuments at multiple entrances multiply the program cost (and are where a single vendor saves you money and keeps the brand consistent).

Typical price ranges

  • Entry-level single-face monument: ~$8,000–$20,000
  • Mid-range illuminated, double-face monument: ~$20,000–$35,000
  • Premium illuminated entrance with masonry, stone, and landscaping: ~$35,000–$60,000+

These are honest ballpark figures for planning. Your actual number depends on the design and site — we quote it fixed.

How long it takes

Most community monument signs take about 4–10 weeks from approved design to installation, depending on permitting, engineering, and foundation work. We coordinate to your community's opening date.

Get a fixed quote

Send your entrance location, community plan, and brand standards and Brand 9 Signs will return a fixed quote and timeline. Orange Park, FL · (904) 272-3395 · Team@brand9signs.com · rated 4.8/5 across 57 reviews.
